backfills.method: Fingerprints computed from the source at the recorded revision, with the working tree verified to still reproduce that survivor set exactly before any fingerprint was taken — never from a tree carrying later edits. Survivor identity (module, func, operator, lineno) is UNCHANGED; the fingerprint is added beside it.
backfills.absent_policy: Where more than one mutation site shares one (operator, lineno) coordinate, the legacy record cannot say which site it was, so the fingerprint is left ABSENT rather than guessed. An absent fingerprint can never match a relocation — it fails closed.
